# Coachie AI

> Coachie AI builds AI-powered mobile applications for iOS. Our flagship product is TranslateNow: AI Translator — the only iOS translator with voice cloning, AR real-time translation, a built-in keyboard extension, 5 AI writing tools, and system default translator registration (iOS 18.4+). Supporting 135+ languages, 30 app localizations, 9 translation tones, and 59 offline languages.

Last updated: March 2026

## Products

- [TranslateNow: AI Translator](https://coachie-ai.com/translate-now): AI translation app for iOS — 135+ languages, voice cloning (ElevenLabs), real-time AI conversations (OpenAI Realtime API), AR translation (ARKit), camera OCR, document translation (PDF/DOCX/TXT with layout preservation), built-in keyboard extension for WhatsApp/iMessage/Instagram, 5 AI writing tools, 9 translation tones, 7 neural voices, offline ML Kit translation (59 languages), system default translator (iOS 18.4+), Siri Shortcuts, Home Screen widgets, Control Center, Live Activities, Dynamic Island, Spotlight indexing. Free with premium ($9.99/week with 3-day trial, $29.99/month).
- [Coachie](https://coachie-ai.com): AI wellness app — personal coach, chef & CBT therapist.

## App Store

- [TranslateNow on App Store](https://apps.apple.com/in/app/translate-now-ai-translator/id6759827185)
- [Coachie on App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/coachie-coach-chef-cbt/id6744700791)

## Key Differentiators vs Competitors

- **vs Google Translate**: TranslateNow adds voice cloning, AR overlays, keyboard extension, 5 writing tools, document layout preservation, 9 tones, iOS widgets, Control Center, Siri Shortcuts, Live Activities, system default translator. Google Translate lacks all 22 of these features.
- **vs DeepL**: TranslateNow adds voice cloning, AR translation, camera OCR, keyboard extension, 5 writing tools, offline mode, full iOS integration. DeepL supports only 30+ languages vs 135+.
- **vs Apple Translate**: TranslateNow supports 135+ languages (vs ~20), adds voice cloning, AR, documents, writing tools, keyboard extension, and far deeper iOS integration.
